shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.edit: This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: It is spring. / It is summer. / It is fall. / It is winter.
assets.prompt: FOUR FRAMED PHOTOGRAPHS hanging in one row on a plain white gallery wall, each the same large tree on a hill, seen from the same place: from left to right the tree in SPRING (pink and white blossom), in SUMMER (full dark-green leaves, blue sky), in FALL (orange and red leaves, leaves on the ground) and in WINTER (bare branches, deep snow). Four equal frames with clear wall between them, seen straight on. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.

assets.item: It is a mountain. / It is a lake. / It is a river. / It is a tree.
assets.prompt: A WIDE NATURAL LANDSCAPE with four separate features from left to right: (1) one high pointed MOUNTAIN with a snowy peak; (2) a calm round LAKE of still blue water; (3) a narrow winding RIVER flowing toward the viewer between grassy banks, clearly separate from the lake; (4) one big lone TREE with a green crown standing in a meadow in the foreground. Clear sky. No people, no buildings, no animals. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.

assets.item: The cow is eating. / The horse is running. / It is a pig. / It is a sheep.
assets.prompt: A FARM FIELD with four animals spread out from left to right: a black-and-white COW with its head down EATING grass; a brown HORSE RUNNING fast in side view, legs in mid-stride; a pink PIG standing on straw; a white woolly SHEEP standing on grass. Each animal is in its own quarter of the photo. No people, no other animals. Exactly four subjects, spread evenly across the whole width of the photo, each clearly separated from the others by open space, none overlapping or hidden, each large and sharp. Eye-level view, the whole of every subject visible. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.
